title: κ = 6.94787513005285e-4: plateau retiming on PR210's 471-source word
body:
## Status and relationship to PR210

This is a Draft stacked on PR210 head `df95878d11190518e45ef9717c9ee05011f88ace`.
The branch parent is that exact commit. Because the target base is `main` while PR210 is still open, GitHub's comparison includes PR210's pending cumulative changes; this PR's new contribution is the frame-plateau search and exact reprice documented under `research/coordinated-crossover-pr200/search/`.

## Result

The candidate certificate gives conditional
`κ = 694787513005285/10^18 = 0.000694787513005285`, an exact gain of
`4793314502/10^18` over PR210's `694782719690783/10^18`.

The deterministic search retimes 19 operation frames in 14 accepted moves:

- op 18750: rank 5 → 6;
- five adjacent pairs (23544/23545, 23591/23592, 23638/23639, 23685/23686, 23732/23733): rank 9 → 12;
- eight operations (27900, 27904, 27908, 27912, 28052, 28056, 28060, 28064): rank 13 → 14.

The `d log d` score proposes moves only. Exact frame containment, nondegeneracy and nested role chains admit the moves. The physical word and scalar operations remain those of PR210. The raw child-histogram delta has weighted-rank change zero and 27 fewer children per vertex. The normalized profile keeps `m=72`, `W=438838`, rank mass `31549872`, deficit `46464` and maximum child `22`. Bit saving improves by `4799982097/10^18`; the bit side remains binding. The exact 47-constraint assembly rejects the adjacent `10^-18` grid point.

## Local checks completed

- `joint-plateau-search-prdf958.py --verify-committed`: deterministic 14-move replay, 19 changed operation frames; passed.
- Candidate source-boundary geometry checks for 440 borrowed sources, three rank-19 gauges and 28 source-backed gauges: passed, including reflected frame paths and target chronology.
- `pack_joint.py`: 231 charts and 3,594,888 bank assignments; passed.
- Exact parent profile calibration reproduced PR210's κ. Candidate `price_joint.py` reproduced the committed candidate certificate and all 47 positive rational constraints.
- The full scalar replay has not been run locally. It is the required Draft CI gate, along with repository-wide CI.

## CI coverage required before review

The package's immutable offline verifier now replays the deterministic search before running the full scalar word, source/dirty restoration, target ledgers, charts, banks, complex lift, independent paid moments and exact assembly. The continued-kappa workflow runs that verifier and checks for workspace changes. The repository workflow runs all 16 `make verify-*` groups on Python 3.11, 3.13 and 3.14, ranked-pair finite verification, and the historical/Gaussian/matrix formal jobs. The Draft should remain pending until these checks finish successfully.

## Public frontier and limits

The pre-submission 229-PR inventory is in `research/coordinated-crossover-pr200/search/FRONTIER-SNAPSHOT.md`. At the latest check PR210 remained open with all 57 GitHub checks passing. PR227 replays an older, lower PR210 head; the higher prices in PR219 and PR224 still have open physical construction obligations.

This remains a conditional finite supplier certificate. The all-size compiler, weighted/restored selector, source-line, routing, prime, precision, fixed analytic tape and finite-bridge assumptions remain inherited. No unconditional integer-multiplication theorem is claimed. `NOTICE` records PR210 and all inherited authors, upstream PRs, licenses and AI-assistance disclosures, plus this extension's sennemmi/OpenAI Codex provenance.

Reproduce with:

```sh
python3 -B research/coordinated-crossover-pr200/search/joint-plateau-search-prdf958.py --verify-committed
python3 -B research/coordinated-crossover-pr200/verify.py --temp-root /tmp
```
